caption:
MRP is not your 30-day lowest price.

MRP is the printed maximum price. Your 30-day lowest price is the lowest price you actually offered in the last 30 days.

From 1 January 2027, when you announce a price reduction in India, the lowest price from the preceding 30 days needs to be shown too.

India Prior Price records your Shopify store's prices automatically. Launching soon. Follow for launch.
